verdict.rationale: Buzz has no documented export feature. Its data does sit in open, standard formats that the product itself exposes: Nostr events readable by any third-party NIP-29 client connecting directly to the relay, and git repos you can push to and pull from with standard git. Self-hosting on your own Postgres/S3 also means "that place is yours." missing for 10: a documented one-step 'export all my data' feature, coverage of non-chat data (canvases, workflows, huddles, uploads) in open formats, migration/leave guidance, and independent hands-on confirmation of a full data exit.
